title: Chapter 69 — Account-Based Growth Planning
intro: The one-page account plan and the planning rhythm.

sections.title: Plan Each Account
sections.content:
Every significant trade account should have a one-page plan: current share, target share, growth strategy, key contacts, and next actions. Review quarterly.

Without a plan, growth is accidental. With a plan, growth is deliberate.

sections.title: Coaching Rule
sections.content:
When evaluating account planning, ask:

Does every major account have a documented growth plan?
Are plans reviewed quarterly — or created and forgotten?
Is growth deliberate — or accidental?
